submission.justification: Algorithm-L2 gave the highest efficiency at every threshold I simulated. Its scan was 20 GeV: 86.9%, 25: 89.4%, 30: 93.4%, 35: 90.1%, 40: 89.0%, so the best point is 30 GeV. Algorithm-L1 gave 86.2% at 30 GeV and Algorithm-L3 gave 73.9% at 35 GeV. I did not scan L3 at other thresholds, but the 2025 summary shows it well below L2. I scanned L2 at 5 GeV steps, so the true optimum could lie between the points.

requirements.evidence: candidate_specs.md says all candidates fit the FPGA resource budget, and links.md says the optical links have enough bandwidth. Latency is not documented, so it is unverified.

requirements.requirement: Highest signal efficiency at the allocated rate (8 kHz)
requirements.evidence: The simulation gives 93.4% for L2 at 30 GeV, the best result across all options and thresholds I ran. The simulation tool reports efficiency at the allocated rate.
